entry.description: `SmtpPickupDirAppender` writes a carriage return from logged content that is not followed by a line feed as `\r`. A strict mail server such as Sendmail refused a picked up mail with such a character (ANT-2026-PC9VIAKD, fixed by @FreeAndNil in https://github.com/apache/logging-log4net/pull/355[#355])
